SENSEX.title: Tuesday/Wednesday low of the week (up weeks)
SENSEX.title_hi: Tezi wale hafte ka low Mangal/Budh ko
SENSEX.claim: In bullish weeks the weekly low tends to form on Tuesday or Wednesday.
SENSEX.summary: Of 496 up weeks, the low formed on Tue/Wed in 31% (random is about 40%). Monday held the low in 58%.
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — Mangal/Budh ko low 31% hafton mein (random ~40%), Somvar ko 58%.

SENSEX.title: Tuesday/Wednesday high of the week (down weeks)
SENSEX.title_hi: Mandi wale hafte ka high Mangal/Budh ko
SENSEX.claim: In bearish weeks the weekly high tends to form on Tuesday or Wednesday.
SENSEX.summary: Of 451 down weeks, the high formed on Tue/Wed in 37% (random is about 40%). Monday held the high in 47%.
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — Mangal/Budh ko high 37% hafton mein (random ~40%), Somvar ko 47%.

SENSEX.title: Tuesday reversal after a down Monday
SENSEX.title_hi: Somvar girne ke baad Mangalvar ko tezi
SENSEX.claim: If Monday closes down, Tuesday tends to reverse up.
SENSEX.summary: After a down Monday, Tuesday closed up 51% of the time vs 52% for all Tuesdays.
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — girte Somvar ke baad Mangalvar 51% baar upar, normal Mangalvar 52%.

SENSEX.title: Wednesday is the strongest trend day
SENSEX.title_hi: Budhvar sabse strong trend wala din
SENSEX.claim: Wednesday delivers the cleanest trending day of the week.
SENSEX.summary: Trend days (body at least 60% of range): Wednesday 38% vs 40% overall. Most trend days fall on Mon.
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — Budhvar trend day 38% vs average 40%; sabse zyada Mon ko.

SENSEX.title: Expiry-day volatility (Sensex Thursday)
SENSEX.title_hi: Expiry ke din zyada hilchal (Sensex Thursday)
SENSEX.claim: Expiry days see larger, sharper moves than other days.
SENSEX.summary: Average high-low range on expiry days 1.01% vs 0.96% on other days; close-to-close move 0.63% vs 0.65%.
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — expiry pe range 1.01% vs baaki din 0.96%.

SENSEX.title: Peak and lean months
SENSEX.claim: Jan, Mar, May, Sep, Nov, Dec are bullish; Jun and Jul lean bearish.
SENSEX.summary: 0 of 8 directional month claims beat the base rate of 58% positive months (29 years of data).
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — 0/8 mahino ka daava data se match hua (29 saal).

SENSEX.title: The opening move is a fake-out
SENSEX.claim: The first move after the open is usually opposite to the day's real direction.
SENSEX.summary: The first hour pointed the opposite way to the day's close in 27% of sessions (random 50%).
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — pehle ghante ki disha 27% din ulti nikli (random 50%).

SENSEX.title: Day's high or low is set in the first hour
SENSEX.title_hi: Din ka high/low pehle ghante mein
SENSEX.claim: The open kill zone frequently prints the high or low of the day.
SENSEX.summary: The first hour held the day's high or low in 78% of sessions (random about 27%).
SENSEX.hi: data se sach nikla — 78% din high ya low pehle ghante mein bana (random ~27%).

SENSEX.title: Opening sweep of PDH/PDL then reversal
SENSEX.title_hi: Subah kal ka high/low tod ke wapsi
SENSEX.claim: When the first hour takes the previous day's high or low, price usually closes back inside.
SENSEX.summary: The first hour swept PDH or PDL on 539 days; the day closed back inside in 42% (random 50%).
SENSEX.hi: data se sabit nahi hua — 539 din subah kal ka high/low toda, 42% din wapas andar band hua.

SENSEX.title: Opening move vs rest of day (fair test)
SENSEX.claim: After the first hour, the rest of the day tends to move against the opening move.
SENSEX.summary: After the first hour, the rest of the day moved opposite to the first-hour move in 47% of sessions (random 50%).

SENSEX.title: Opening PDH/PDL sweep: rejection close vs holding beyond
SENSEX.claim: A first-hour sweep of yesterday's high/low that closes back inside reverses more often than one that holds beyond.
SENSEX.summary: With a rejection close in the first hour, the day closed back inside 71% of the time vs 26% when the first hour held beyond.

SENSEX.title: Rule: fade a first-hour sweep that closes back inside
SENSEX.claim: Trade against a first-hour PDH/PDL sweep that closes back inside; stop beyond the first-hour extreme; exit at the previous-day midpoint or the close.
SENSEX.summary: 197 trades: win rate 55%, average +0.01R per trade, total +1.5R (before costs).
SENSEX.sample: 2 years of hourly data; costs and slippage not included

SENSEX.title: Rule: follow a first-hour break that holds beyond
SENSEX.claim: Trade with a first-hour break of PDH/PDL that closes beyond it; stop at the other end of the first hour; exit at the close.
SENSEX.summary: 347 trades: win rate 47%, average +0.14R per trade, total +47.4R (before costs).
SENSEX.sample: 2 years of hourly data; costs and slippage not included

SENSEX.title: Robustness: follow a first-hour break that holds
SENSEX.claim: Following a first-hour PDH/PDL break that closes beyond stays profitable in both halves of the sample and after costs.
SENSEX.summary: Halves: +0.18R and +0.09R (both positive). After futures-like costs -0.07R per trade (z -0.7); after conservative costs -0.54R. Average stop distance 0.41% of price.
SENSEX.sample: 2 years of hourly data; options theta/IV not modelled; multiple tests were run, so treat Weak results with caution

SENSEX.title: Robustness: fade a first-hour sweep that closes back inside
